title: Fair Winds Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - One house from the Savannah Private Beach Access in Seaside - You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Spacious wrap around screened in porch - Two beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Fully Stocked Kitchen - Private parking spot with 2 additional parking passes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) Fair Winds will cool you as you sit on the screened porch just steps from the beach entrance. This classic beach cottage sits on a desirable corner lot, directly across from the Savannah Street beach pavilion and two short blocks from the shops and restaurants of Central Square. Freshly painted in cool beach blues and greens, Fair Winds has plenty of room for six guests. When entering Fair Winds, you’re greeted with a corner dining space with a large table that will seat the whole family. The large open family room has a vaulted ceiling, cooled by ceiling fans. The turquoise-tiled cook’s newly renovated kitchen is well-equipped with everything you need to cook and serve full meals, and a breakfast bar offers additional seating. When you don’t feel like cooking, barbecue your family’s favorites on the charcoal grill in the front yard. After dinner, enjoy a movie on the flat-screen TV, or choose from a large selection of books and board games to entertain the whole family. Down a short hallway, you’ll find the king master bedroom with soothing beach themed quilt and artwork and a mounted flat screen TV. The attached master bath offers granite tile, a full shower/bath, and a large, mirrored closet. The guest bedroom has a queen-size bed and a large built-in closet. There is a second bath in the hall with custom tile work and a walk-in shower. A second-floor loft with two twin beds provides additional sleeping space, with a door to the room to allow some privacy. The loft also offers a private balcony with a sweeping view of the gulf waters. Outside Fair Winds, you'll enjoy a wrap-around screened porch with several chairs and a swing and beautiful landscaping that offers both shade and privacy. A variety of beach chairs and toys provide everything you need for a day on the sparkling white sand, and an outdoor hot-and-cold shower enclosure allows you to wash off the beach sand at the end of the day. A one-bedroom guest cottage, Following Seas (rents separately VRBO 219335), provides additional space for two more guests for larger family gatherings. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 6) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Queen, Hall bathroom (shower only) Bedroom 2: King / private bathroom (shower only), TV 2nd floor- Loft with two twin beds ADDITIONAL DETAILS: * Parking for 2 cars * Sorry, no pets allowed ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
